steps.say: Side and level decide everything in sciatica. A prolapse irritates one root, and the map of skin and muscle tells you which.
steps.tx: **Posterolateral L4-L5 and L5-S1 prolapses** (back-side disc bursts) are commonest, compressing the **traversing root** (passing nerve) so an L5-S1 disc hits S1 while a **far-lateral disc** (side exit burst) hits the exiting root one level above the disc space, and central prolapses compress the sac rather than single roots.

vis.alt: Axial disc diagram with posterolateral herniation compressing the nerve root plus leg pain map.
vis.caption: Posterolateral herniation compressing the traversing root. Credit: StewardMD.

steps.say: Foot drop points to L5 while a lost ankle jerk points to S1. Test the movements and reflexes before ordering any scan.
steps.tx: **L5 root pain** (outer leg nerve pain) runs to the dorsum of foot with weak dorsiflexion and **extensor hallucis** (big toe lifter), while **S1 pain** (back calf nerve pain) runs to the lateral foot with weak plantarflexion and a lost **ankle jerk** (heel reflex).

vis.alt: Body dermatome map with segmental skin zones and nerve root levels.
vis.caption: Dermatome map for root localisation. Credit: Mikael Haggstrom (public domain).

steps.say: The leg raise test remains king at the bedside. Pain shooting below the knee before sixty degrees means root tension.
steps.tx: **Straight-leg raise** (leg lift test) below **60 degrees** (sixty degrees) reproducing leg pain and a **crossed SLR** (other side pain) strongly predict a prolapse that matches the MRI level and side, with hip and sacroiliac disease excluded by direct palpation, plus femoral stretch testing L2 to L4 roots in anterior thigh pain.

steps.say: Bladder changes and saddle numbness end the routine pathway. Those two findings convert sciatica into an emergency scan.
steps.tx: **Red flags** (danger signs) of retention, **saddle numbness** (seat area loss), bilateral sciatica or severe unremitting pain convert sciatica into an MRI emergency for **cauda equina** (horse tail roots) or infection or tumour within hours, with saddle sensation tested by pinprick in every sciatica case.

steps.say: Most discs settle without surgery. Six to twelve weeks of honest conservative care cures the majority.
steps.tx: Most prolapses improve within **6 to 12 weeks** (six to twelve weeks) of analgesia, physiotherapy and graded return to work, starting with **conservative 6 weeks** (six week non-surgery trial), and routine early MRI without red flags or deficit does not change management or speed recovery, with epidural steroid shots bridging severe pain flares.

steps.say: SPORT showed surgery wins early but ties late. Persistent disabling leg pain beyond six weeks earns a microdiscectomy.
steps.tx: **SPORT trial** (spine surgery study) showed surgery relieves leg pain faster with equal long-term outcomes, so **microdiscectomy** (keyhole disc removal) is offered for persistent disabling sciatica beyond **6 weeks** (six weeks), progressive deficit or intolerable pain despite care, equal on intention-to-treat while as-treated analyses favoured surgery.

steps.say: Endplate signals and travelling fragments refine the plan. Migrated pieces suit targeted removal without full exposure.
steps.tx: **Modic endplate changes** (bone marrow signals) and high-intensity zones mark painful degenerative discs but do not mandate fusion alone, while **sequestrated fragments** (travelling disc bits, **sequestration**) migrating behind the body suit a targeted **fragmentectomy** (piece removal), with Modic type 1 oedema hurting more than fatty type 2 change.

steps.say: Same-level return of pain needs a stability check. Instability, wide bone removal or chronic back pain push toward fusion.
steps.tx: **Recurrent prolapse** (repeat burst) at the same level after **6 months** (six months) gets redo discectomy, while instability, bilateral **facetectomy** (joint removal) or chronic axial pain push the decision toward **fusion** (bone joining operation) with cages and screws, with smoking cessation mandatory before any fusion booking.
